caption: The drawing shows a single metallic object centered on a plain light beige background. The object appears to be cylindrical at the top with two small protrusions and a flat circular surface. Beneath the cylinder, there is a narrow neck that leads into a wider, rounded base, which flares out circularly and rests flat against the surface. The object is rendered in shades of grey and silver, with shading and highlights indicating its metallic nature. The artist’s signature, “H. Lyman Brown,” appears in the lower left corner. There are no other objects or decorations in the image, and the entire composition is simple and focused entirely on the metallic form.
title: Lamp
